entities.summary: Lakva Sim,, is a Mongolian former professional boxer who competed from 1995 to 2005. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) super-featherweight title in 1999 and the WBA lightweight title in 2004. He is also the first Mongolian boxer to capture a world title.
